shade_resolution.status: planning envelopes, not published universal standards
shade_resolution.rule: Check narrow-walkway representation and compare route/spot outcomes between grids; retain explicit3D occluders where a height raster loses overhang/undercroft geometry.

urrock_resolution.status: manual defaults used as proposed starting values; validate local geometry, not a performance guarantee

cfd_resolution.initial_rule: Local target spacing derived from building volume and passage width (10cells initial minimum), then systematic refinement; vertical sampling/near-wall treatment separately specified.
cfd_resolution.status: proposal informed by COST732 and a London industry precedent; numeric lengths conditional on actual geometry and target phenomena
cfd_resolution.refinement_plan: Three systematic RANS grids; preserve geometry and sample locations, quantify discretisation sensitivity; do not claim formal error estimate when extrapolation assumptions fail.

studio_proposals.acceptance: Predeclare decision-relevant effect and uncertainty; check source/geometry, grid/domain/inlet sensitivity, residuals plus targets and balances, suitableAIJbenchmark and independent site measurements. Existing project numeric screens are historical project thresholds, not consensus physical-validation limits.
studio_proposals.cost_planning: No timing or solver benchmark run now. After separate execution authorization: inspect live hardware; measure representative geometry/radiation/wind unit and cells/iterations throughput, RAM/VRAM; estimate total; run independent cases together and checkpoint. No wall-clock cap or arbitrary fixedGiB limit.
studio_proposals.membership_rule: Whole-footprint strictFigure5 membership controls reported building inventory; crossing/exterior buildings may still be necessary physical wind/shade context. Keep separate flags and never clip or drop context merely because it lies outside the reporting mask.
geometry_products: Highest available verified officialLOD for untextured scene, with per-object source/LOD/yearcoverage
Audited and simplified but physically relevant occluders for radiation
Watertight, nonintersecting, purpose-builtCFDsolids with local relevant details
studio_proposals.reuse: Raw sources, IDs, metadata, source-weather records and checked parsing/diagnostic code may be reused. A reporting-mask-only change can reuse a previously accepted field only with coverage/physics checks. Current legacy unaccepted fields and changed geometry do not pass that condition.
